desc: This Yankee Hill Machine Picatinny Rail Section allows you to mount Picatinny accessories to your M-Lok handguard. The Continuous M-Lok Rail System or C.M.R.S. can be mounted end-to-end to create a continuous Picatinny rail. Made from 6061-T6 aluminum that is hardcoat anodized and feature stainless M-Lok screws and nuts. Requires 1/8" Hex Allen Wrench to install.
